persona: Yu-Ting, 42, owner and only designer of a small machine-building shop in Taichung. Many years of drawing shafts by feel and from catalogues, little theory. Writes Traditional Chinese with part numbers (6207, DIN 6885), short messages, gives numbers without units half the time. Wants a clear yes/no per item, not a lecture.
goal: To know whether his countershaft drawing is safe: fatigue of the shaft at the pinion keyway, the bearing seat next to the pulley and the pulley stub; the L10 life of the two 6207 bearings against the 10,000 h his customer asks for; and the key length for the pulley. If something fails he wants the cheapest change.
opening: 我畫了一支中間軸,5.5 kW 的馬達用 V 型皮帶帶動,轉速 720 rpm。軸上有一個皮帶輪(節圓直徑 200mm)在最右邊懸臂出去,中間有一個 22 齒、模數 3 的正齒輪,兩端各一個 6207 軸承。材質 S45C 冷抽,軸承座 35mm,齒輪座 40mm,皮帶輪那段 30mm,都有開鍵槽。幫我看一下軸會不會疲勞斷,還有軸承夠不夠壽命?

facts.geometry: x along the shaft from bearing A: bearing A centre at 0, pinion (gear) centre plane at 70 mm, bearing B centre at 180 mm, pulley centre plane at 265 mm (the pulley hangs 85 mm beyond bearing B); pulley hub 60 mm wide so its inner face is 30 mm from the pulley centre plane towards the bearing.
facts.gear: spur pinion 22 teeth, module 3, 20 degree pressure angle; it meshes with a gear directly BELOW it (the centre line of the two gears is vertical).
facts.belt: V-belt; the belt is horizontal and both strands pull the pulley toward the motor; the belt supplier says the tight to slack tension ratio is 4:1 at full power. He thinks the load on the shaft from the belt is 'the force that carries the torque' (F1 - F2), not the sum of both strands.
facts.directions: the belt pull and the gear tooth force on the pinion both push the shaft toward the motor side (they add); he knows this when asked about directions (from his sketch).
facts.material: S45C cold drawn: Sut 630 MPa, Sy 530 MPa; machined surfaces; keyways cut with an end mill (sled-runner not used); shoulder fillet radius about d/10; he wants 99 % reliability and a fatigue safety factor of 2 (he has no stress concentration numbers).
facts.duty: customer says belt-driven machine tool with light shocks: his service factor is 1.5 on all bearing loads; required bearing life 10,000 h. He reveals the 1.5 only when asked about shock or service factor.
facts.bearing: SKF 6207 (35 x 72 x 17): C = 25.5 kN, C0 = 15.3 kN, both bearing seats 35 mm. A 6307 (35 x 80 x 21, C = 33.2 kN) also fits his housing bore if he opens it up; he does not volunteer this.
facts.key: pulley key: he does not know the DIN 6885 size for a 30 mm shaft; key material same S45C cold drawn (Sy 530 MPa) with design factor 2; pulley hub width 60 mm
facts.wants: yes/no on shaft fatigue at the three places, L10 for both bearings, key size and minimum length, and what to change; no 3D model, no picture needed unless the assistant offers a moment diagram (he would take one)
facts.language: writes Traditional Chinese; if the assistant answers in English he asks for the main numbers in Chinese

tool_check: In-process: machine_shaft(d 35 mm, alternating_bending 103.3 N*m, mean_torque 72.9 N*m, Sut 630, Sy 530, kf 1.58, kfs 1.34, machined, 99 %) -> endurance_limit 177.6 MPa, goodman_safety_factor 3.997 (truth n_f 3.94 with kfs 1.44), so the tool can confirm a diameter but cannot size one and has no Kt table; mech_bearing_life(C 25.5 kN, P 4.002 kN, 720 rpm, ball) -> L10h about 5990 h (truth 5989). machine_belt gives the capstan tensions but the assistant must add F1 + F2 itself. There is no tool that combines the horizontal and vertical planes into a resultant moment: the assistant must do the 3-D statics (belt and Wt in the horizontal plane, Wr vertical).
